amendments.title: Founder Approved Requirement Amendment
amendments.old_value: Do not begin a later milestone until the current gate has clean evidence and no unresolved P0/P1 defect. An adverse independent verdict pauses progression; disputes follow builder response, reviewer rebuttal and founder decision. Overrides remain recorded, name the affected requirement/rule and are re-examined at the next audit.
amendments.new_value: Do not begin a later milestone while any P0 remains unresolved, or while any P1 affects product scope, security, money, authority, milestone executability, acceptance completeness or canonical correctness. A P1 limited to publication, projection, wording, identifier or validator coverage may proceed only through recorded founder adjudication when canonical behavior is correct, runtime behavior cannot change, the defect remains visible and repair is scheduled. An adverse independent verdict pauses progression until the builder response, reviewer rebuttal and founder decision are recorded. Overrides name the affected requirement or rule and are re-examined at the next audit.
amendments.change:
Old: Do not begin a later milestone until the current gate has clean evidence and no unresolved P0/P1 defect. An adverse independent verdict pauses progression; disputes follow builder response, reviewer rebuttal and founder decision. Overrides remain recorded, name the affected requirement/rule and are re-examined at the next audit.
New: Do not begin a later milestone while any P0 remains unresolved, or while any P1 affects product scope, security, money, authority, milestone executability, acceptance completeness or canonical correctness. A P1 limited to publication, projection, wording, identifier or validator coverage may proceed only through recorded founder adjudication when canonical behavior is correct, runtime behavior cannot change, the defect remains visible and repair is scheduled. An adverse independent verdict pauses progression until the builder response, reviewer rebuttal and founder decision are recorded. Overrides name the affected requirement or rule and are re-examined at the next audit.
amendments.reason: Align the requirement with the approved stopping rule: substantive P1 remains blocking, bounded publication/projection debt may proceed only through recorded adjudication.
amendments.verification: Exact wording is asserted by the standard-library validator.

amendments.title: Requirement Split
amendments.new_value: 72 successor requirements with full original lineage.
amendments.change:
Old: 32 original mixed-behavior requirements.
New: 72 successor requirements with full original lineage.
amendments.reason: Different introducing gates, evidence or positive/negative phase-boundary behavior.
amendments.verification: Every original is mapped to all successors; active IDs are unique; no successor depends on a later gate.
amendments.residual_risk: Human semantic coverage remains subject to Codex audit.

amendments.title: Canonical test-ID namespace
amendments.old_value: Top-level acceptance IDs and clause engineering-test IDs diverged on 18 requirements.
amendments.new_value: Top-level test IDs equal the ordered clause union; single- and multi-clause formats are explicit.
amendments.change: Top-level test IDs equal the ordered clause union; single- and multi-clause formats are explicit.
amendments.verification: Validator enforces exact equality, gate coverage and active-ID prefixes.

amendments.title: Occurrence-linked forbidden-surface semantics
amendments.old_value: Negation and sense exclusions could authorize unrelated forbidden occurrences within a sentence or requirement.
amendments.new_value: Each forbidden occurrence is evaluated in its own adversative clause; negation must govern that occurrence, double-negation fails, and sense exclusions require approved phrase patterns.
amendments.change: Replaced sentence-wide and requirement-wide authorization with occurrence-linked negation and exact phrase/sense matching.
amendments.verification: Mandatory probes include all four Codex bypasses, cross-sentence/adversative variants, double negation, and permitted senses.
amendments.residual_risk: Automated scanning does not replace independent human semantic review.

amendments.title: D-100 JSON projection wording
amendments.old_value: D-100 referred to narrative, YAML and workbook projections although controlled machine-readable projections are JSON.
amendments.new_value: D-100 refers to narrative, JSON and workbook projections.
amendments.change: Corrected the projection-format name and regenerated all decision publications.
amendments.verification: Decision JSON, workbook, Markdown, DOCX and PDF contain identical corrected wording.
